long_biography.plain_text:
Malouf opened his own Parramatta practice in 1995 after leaving an earlier partnership. He centred it on motor accident, workers’ compensation and public liability claims, and chose to self-fund case disbursements rather than use outside funders. Offices soon followed across Sydney, regional New South Wales and other states.

The practice later broadened into medical negligence, institutional abuse, estate disputes and commercial class actions. Malouf remains a principal and chairman, but day-to-day firm leadership is now shared: David Cossalter serves as managing partner, with other lawyers holding senior and equity-partner roles. Malouf’s professional standing includes personal injury specialist accreditation and admission in New South Wales and the High Court of Australia.
